dedup_scope: Canonical URLs and title/DOI identifiers checked against the central ledger and accessible local manifests for Batches 458–467. Duplicate URLs and localized mirrors were excluded. Global semantic deduplication remains incomplete.

accepted_sources.title: Visual-Based Error Diffusion for Printers
accepted_sources.read_depth: Repository page and abstract read; linked thesis PDF could not be fetched.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Printer-model and visual-model-aware error diffusion; low-frequency local errors may be more objectionable than high-frequency noise.

accepted_sources.title: Feature-Preserving Multiscale Error Diffusion for Digital Halftoning
accepted_sources.read_depth: Repository record and linked seven-page PDF read; counted as one work.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Addresses directional hysteresis, dot-polarity bias, flat-region pattern noise and boundary effects; warns against edge-enhancement preprocessing that distorts intensities.

accepted_sources.title: Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Natural Image Matting Using Initial Alpha Mattes
accepted_sources.read_depth: PubMed metadata and abstract read; publisher full text not retrieved.
accepted_sources.key_finding: CNN refines complementary closed-form and KNN initial mattes; paper also describes RGB-guided JPEG-artifact removal.

accepted_sources.title: Image Matting with AVCLabs PhotoPro AI
accepted_sources.key_finding: Workflow separates object selection, matting, transparent preview, background replacement and export; not an accuracy benchmark.

accepted_sources.title: Coarse Semantic Guided Alpha Matting via Simultaneous Foreground and Background Estimation
accepted_sources.read_depth: Metadata and abstract read; full-text body not retrievable.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Joint foreground/background/alpha prediction targets color spill; coarse semantics are refined by an encoder-decoder.

accepted_sources.title: Contour Extraction of Transparent Objects Using Fully Convolutional Networks
accepted_sources.read_depth: English abstract and metadata read; Japanese full paper not retrieved.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Two FCN methods extract transparent-object contours; the contour-neighborhood task is reported to perform better.

accepted_sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Sampling-Based Image Matting
accepted_sources.read_depth: Abstract and visible references read; full text not retrieved.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Recommends isolating sampling strategy from weights, post-processing and other refinements in controlled comparisons.

accepted_sources.title: Shared Sampling for Real-Time Alpha Matting
accepted_sources.read_depth: Abstract and supporting-information description read; full article access not obtained.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Reuses selected foreground/background sample pairs to reduce redundant computation; the paper reports up to 100x speedup.

accepted_sources.title: SigCleaner — Background Removal for Stamps and Signatures
accepted_sources.read_depth: Visible feature, processing and API overview read.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Specialized extraction workflow; remote processing makes it a capability reference, not a default for private customer artwork.

accepted_sources.title: SigCleaner REST API Documentation
accepted_sources.read_depth: Visible API documentation read, including upload, file listing, deletion, renaming and error codes.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Bearer-authenticated file/URL input and PNG/WebP output; remote retention and URL-fetch security need separate review.

accepted_sources.title: Signature Cleaner — Remove Background, Export Transparent PNG
accepted_sources.key_finding: Four-corner background sampling, color-distance-to-alpha soft ramp and optional trim; corner contamination can bias results.

accepted_sources.title: Alpha Matting With KL-Divergence-Based Sparse Sampling
accepted_sources.read_depth: PubMed metadata and abstract read; publisher full text not retrieved.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Frames sample selection as sparse subset selection and compares candidates using KL-divergence between local feature distributions.

accepted_sources.title: AlphaNet: An Attention Guided Deep Network for Automatic Image Matting
accepted_sources.read_depth: HTML paper opened; architecture, trimap generation, attention-guided up/downsampling and evaluation sections read.
accepted_sources.key_finding: Combines segmentation, erosion/dilation trimap generation and attention-guided matting; reports MSE/SAD/gradient/connectivity metrics.

accepted_sources.title: White — Document Component
accepted_sources.key_finding: Documents white-plate methods, positive spread/negative choke, minimum-alpha cutoff, spot mapping and No Choke on White; helps prevent duplicate underbase generation.
